(async () => { const out = { auto: [] }; for (const u of ['/photo1.jpg','/pose.jpg','/photo5.jpg']) { await MM.app.testing.loadFromUrl('http://127.0.0.1:8137/.test' + u); await MM.app.testing.runAuto(); const s = JSON.parse(MM.app.testing.dump()); const m = s.measurements, e = s.estimate; out.auto.push({ u, phase: s.phase, ok: e && e.ok, reason: e && e.reason, cm: e && e.cm, conf: e && e.confidence100, band: e && e.band && e.band.key, anchors: e && e.usableAnchors, heads: (e && e.headsTall != null) ? +e.headsTall.toFixed(2) : null, notes: (e && e.notes) ? e.notes.map(n => n.level + ': ' + n.text.slice(0, 48)) : null }); } return JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); })()

(() => { const st = () => MM.app.testing.state(); const out = {}; out.cm23a = st().estimate.cm; MM.app.testing.setHeadCm(21); out.cm21 = st().estimate.cm; MM.app.testing.setHeadCm(25); out.cm25 = st().estimate.cm; MM.app.testing.setHeadCm(23); out.cm23b = st().estimate.cm; const m = JSON.parse(MM.app.testing.dump()).measurements; const crown = { x: m.points.crown.x / m.imageW, y: m.points.crown.y / m.imageH }; const widthHead = m.headPxFromWidth / m.imageH; window.__auto = { crown, chinHuman: { x: crown.x, y: crown.y + widthHead }, chinFit: { x: m.points.chin.x / m.imageW, y: m.points.chin.y / m.imageH }, feet: { x: m.points.feet[0].x / m.imageW, y: m.points.footY / m.imageH }, imgW: m.imageW, imgH: m.imageH, autoCm: out.cm23b, widthHeadPx: Math.round(m.headPxFromWidth) }; out.widthHeadPx = window.__auto.widthHeadPx; return JSON.stringify(out); })()

(() => { document.getElementById('calcDetails').open = false; MM.app.testing.enterManual(); const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const fire = (type, n, extra) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, Object.assign({ bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height }, extra || {}))); const A = window.__auto; for (const p of [A.crown, A.chinFit, A.feet]) { fire('pointerdown', p); fire('pointerup', p); } MM.app.testing.manualCalc(); const st = MM.app.testing.state(); const warn = document.getElementById('manualWarn'); return JSON.stringify({ phase: st.phase, taps: MM.manual.points().length, warnShown: !warn.classList.contains('hidden'), warnText: warn.textContent.slice(0, 120), primaryDisabled: document.getElementById('primaryBtn').disabled }); })()

(() => { const A = window.__auto; MM.app.testing.setManualPoints([A.crown, A.chinHuman, A.feet]); const warn = document.getElementById('manualWarn'); const cleared = warn.classList.contains('hidden'); const measOf = () => MM.geometry.measureFromManual(MM.manual.points(), A.imgW, A.imgH); const cmOf = () => MM.anthropometry.estimate(measOf(), { headCm: 23 }).cm; const cmBefore = cmOf(); const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const fire = (type, n, extra) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, Object.assign({ bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 4, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height }, extra || {}))); const before = MM.manual.points()[1]; fire('pointerdown', before); const up = { x: before.x + 0.004, y: before.y - 0.012 }; fire('pointermove', up); const movedPx = Math.round(Math.abs(MM.manual.points()[1].y - before.y) * rect.height); const cmUp = cmOf(); fire('pointermove', before); fire('pointerup', before); const backPx = Math.round(Math.abs(MM.manual.points()[1].y - before.y) * rect.height); return JSON.stringify({ cleared, movedPx, backPx, cmBefore, cmUp, draggingCleared: MM.manual.getActiveIdx() === -1 }); })()

(() => { const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const n = MM.manual.points()[1]; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 3, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height })); const l = document.getElementById('loupe'); return JSON.stringify({ loupeVisible: getComputedStyle(l).display !== 'none' }); })()

(() => { const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const n = MM.manual.points()[1]; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 3, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height })); MM.app.testing.manualCalc(); const s = JSON.parse(MM.app.testing.dump()); const e = s.estimate || {}; return JSON.stringify({ phase: s.phase, source: s.measurements && s.measurements.source, cm: e.cm, conf: e.confidence100, band: e.band && e.band.key, heads: (e.headsTall != null) ? +e.headsTall.toFixed(2) : null, anchors: e.usableAnchors, err: e.errorCm, notes: (e.notes || []).map(n => n.text.slice(0, 60)), autoCm: window.__auto.autoCm }); })()

(() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 600; c.height = 900; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#8a8f96'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 600, 900); window.__grayUrl = c.toDataURL('image/png'); return 'gray=' + window.__grayUrl.length; })()

(async () => { await MM.app.testing.loadFromUrl(window.__grayUrl, 'gray.png'); await MM.app.testing.runAuto(); const s = MM.app.testing.state(); return JSON.stringify({ phase: s.phase, title: document.getElementById('errorTitle').textContent, errorCardShown: !document.getElementById('errorCard').classList.contains('hidden'), manualBtnShown: !document.getElementById('btnManualFromError').closest('.hidden') }); })()
